# Draft:List of Hull Kingston Rovers seasons

Hull Kingston Rovers are an English professional rugby league club based in Kingston upon Hull, East Riding of Yorkshire. Founded in 1882 as Kingston Amateurs by a group of apprentice boilermakers in the Hessle Road area, taking on its current name during their 1885-86 season, the club has competed in the sport since being admitted into the Northern Football Union in 1899. This list details the club's achievements in all major competitions.
